title: Vanishing average under coordinate flip
statement: Let $q$ be a real-valued function on the sign cube of dimension $n$, and fix a coordinate $i$. If flipping coordinate $i$ negates $q$ at every point, then the uniform average of $q$ over the cube is $0$.
